AIIMS Darbhanga OPD crosses one lakh patients

The outpatient department at AIIMS Darbhanga has crossed one lakh patient visits in a single month for the first time, officials said.

The institute credited newly commissioned specialty blocks in cardiology, neurology and oncology for the surge in footfall from north Bihar and adjoining Nepal.

Hospital administrators said average waiting time has still been held under two hours through token staggering and evening clinics.

Patient groups welcomed the milestone but flagged overcrowded waiting halls and sought more seating and drinking water facilities.

The institute plans to add 200 beds and a new trauma centre by next year, officials added.
